coordinates: X increases southeast along the west wall. Y increases inward, Z above the street. The photos are rectilinear extractions of independently dated street panoramas. Every pixel uses the full raster top-left as origin. Detail matrix = lens(detail) @ inv(lens(panorama registration view)) @ calibrated P, only for the same panorama ID. Triangulation fits the measured rays by homogeneous least squares; image errors and marginal observations are retained. Rectangular fits average the two jamb or sill/head coordinates on the specified constant-depth plane.
